text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, El Condor Pasa
stopped in her tracks as if remembering something.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Come to think of it, my favorite female wrestler
has a match coming up very soon!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
They are quite young, but their skills are the real deal,
and they're even called a contender for world champion, yes-desu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: He's a wrestler I've been cheering for ever since his debuuuut!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Its name is "Elcondor" too,
so it's a bit like El,ãã¹!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, Trainer,
would you like to come cheer with me?!

Hearing that it was the wrestler
El Condor Pasa admired,
I couldn't help but be curious.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I'll be looking forward to it, then!
And on the day of the match—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
WOOOAAAH, EL CONDOR!
RIGHT THEEEERE!! GOOOOOOO!

A match buzzing with excitement before a massive crowd.
A heated battle unfolded.
And the one who emerged victorious was...

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
"I won!!
My goal is to become world champion! To prove I'm the strongest in the world!!
I'm one step closer now!!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whew! That was so hooooot, yeeees!
And that declaration just now...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The thrill never fades!!
That immense power! That bravery! That fighting spirit!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You just have to respect that!
Don't you think so too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Indeed, that was a great match!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Trainer,
now we can take our time and discuss today's match—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...Que? Ah, could that be...!
The person over there is--!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me!
Um... El Condor-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text: ...And you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was watching your race earlier!
I was cheering for you the whole time...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
"I'm glad, thank you!
You're an Umamusume, right?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! And so... it's also my dream
to prove in races that I'm the strongest in the world!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
So... do you want to compete
to see who can prove they're the world's strongest first!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I'll fight on the turf!
And you'll fight in the ring!!

Still riding her wave of excitement, El Condor Pasa
chatted away to Elicondor.
Elicondor didn't look displeased at all—

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text:
Interesting! You're on!
I'll be the one standing at the very top of the World Championship!

text_block_list.name: El Condor
text_block_list.text: —And I'll do it before you!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
! ...No, I won't lose!
I'll definitely reach it first!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It was like a dream.
To think I'd actually get to meet El Condor!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The stages may be different,
but our goal is the same: proving who is the strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In that sense, El Condor is
my rival too!!

El Condor Pasa's eyes
are ablaze with fighting spirit.
To hype things up here—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure!?
In that case, we're having yakinikuuu!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I hear El Condor eats several kilograms of
meat a day, yes, she does!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: El can't afford to lose either!! I need to build up my stamina with meat and give it my all!

Unable to say no to El Condor Pasa's beaming smile,
I ended up having to treat her to several kilograms of yakiniku...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bring it oooon!
Let's do this, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Now, can you keep up with me?!
No holding back, no mercy, babyyy!

El Condor Pasa dashes off.
Without a vehicle, there was no way I could catch up to her, but—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOO!
I'll definitely prove I'm the strongest in the world~!!

Thanks to a fantastic race and a lovely coincidence,
it became an unforgettable, fun-filled day.
